candidates.change_summary: Pass jojoTeam instead of msg.sender as the new oracle's owner, so the deployed oracle's owner() observable via the oracle address differs.
Emit the event with jojoTeam instead of msg.sender as the owner argument, changing the observable event data.
Deploy the oracle with an empty description instead of the provided one, so the new oracle's description() observable via the oracle address differs.
Invert the access check so that only callers who are NOT the JOJO team can create oracles, changing revert/commit behavior on calls.
Deploy the EmergencyOracle with owner jojoTeam instead of msg.sender, changing the deployed oracle's ownership and observable address/behavior.
Deploy the EmergencyOracle with an empty description instead of the caller-supplied description, so the deployed oracle's public description() reads differently.
Remove the deployment of the new EmergencyOracle so no oracle contract is created; the emitted address is msg.sender and no oracle exists at it.
Remove the require check so any caller, not just the JOJO team, can call newEmergencyOracle and create an oracle.
